title: C29: red-band WaveTrend sells in a downtrend on 10m / 15m / 30m (trend from the same chart or from 2h)

what.name: Trend
what.value_plain: same chart: swing-break structure on the trading chart; 2h: structure of the last CLOSED 2h bar
what.label: OURS

what.name: Rules / exits
what.value_plain: as C28 (sell dot >= 53 or >= 0 in a downtrend, buy dots in an uptrend; exits X1-X4; cap 60 bars)
what.label: OURS

what.name: Costs
what.value_plain: 0.10% per round trip (Binance taker x2, backtest/fees.py); slippage and funding not modelled
what.label: SOURCED

how: wt_lower_tf.py on Binance spot 5m from 2022 built into 10m/15m/30m.
window: 2022-01-01 to 2026-10-31, split 2022-01..2024-06 vs 2024-07..now (whole history was read: a seen-period check, not a sealed test)

verdict.label: Frequency fixed, profit not: with the 2h downtrend as context red-band sells happen often (10m n 321, 15m 187, 30m 63) but lose on 10m/15m; 30m about flat.

why: With the trend read on the same small chart, red-band sells stay rare (3-9 in 2.5 years): the context has to come from a higher chart.
10m and 15m red-band sells lose with every exit (-0.04% to -0.21% per trade after fees).
30m with the 2h downtrend: +0.18% per trade with exit X3 (n 61, both halves positive, t 0.5): too weak to call.

examples.title: Downtrend red-band sells (sell dot >= 53), net per trade after fees
